admission.justification: One cross-surface rest/focus contract prevents pointer transit from producing misleading relation changes or breaking keyboard/reduced-motion access.

applicability: Pointer/focus relation highlighting on sprint Order rows and the complete graph.
conditions: Pointer highlighting waits180ms; keyboard focus marks immediately.
Reduced motion removes the fade, not the rest delay.
Rows and graph share relation/rest semantics; passing between rows does not blank the picture.
exclusions: Opening a graph without user navigation.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/order-block.test.tsx: the four tests of 'the mark of the order rows (rule 11)'; dashboard/src/panels/sprint-graph/sprint-graph-highlight.test.tsx (unchanged, green); notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f6/sandbox/look2-capture.json probes.order (60 ms: none; rested: self, related x2, other x2; after leaving: none)

statement: The order rows of a sprint mark a unit and its relations only after the pointer has rested 180 ms, at once on keyboard focus, with a fade that reduced motion drops; they use the same rest and relation functions as the graph.
